usageNote: 时间短语！'next week'是下周，'after next week'就是下下周，超实用的口语表达！

examples.en: The project deadline is after next week, so we still have some time.
examples.zh: 项目截止日期是下下周，所以我们还有一些时间。

examples.en: Can we reschedule the meeting to after next week? I'm too busy right now.
examples.zh: 我们能把会议改到下下周吗？我现在太忙了。
